Plot one connected scalar signal from the live simulation.

Properties reads the connected input value and simulation timestamp from GraphExecutor. It does not synthesize preview data.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Signal](../categories/signal.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `SignalScope` |
| Search words | scope, plot, monitor, simulation, scalar |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Signal** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Connected scalar simulation signal |

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | Window size | `window_size` | Integer | `500` | `10-100000` | The editor only | Maximum retained samples. |
| Display | Auto scale | `auto_scale` | On / off | `true` |   | The editor only | Automatically fit the value axis. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: SignalScope belongs to the GraphExecutor scalar simulation lane; PipelineExecutor does not execute interactive simulation sinks |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Runtime | fail closed | No | SignalScope belongs to the GraphExecutor scalar simulation lane; PipelineExecutor does not execute interactive simulation sinks |
| Fail Mode | hard fail | No | As above |
| Pipeline Executor | unsupported | No | As above |
| Materializer | none | No | As above |
| Implementation Owner | graph executor | Yes | GraphExecutor owns bounded scalar control evaluation for the live simulation lane; PipelineExecutor and the training backend reject it. |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |
| Workflow Lane | simulation | Yes | As above |
| Simulation Runtime | supported | Yes | As above |
